manifest.title: One auditable comparison: presence, location and shape, bounds beside achieved

strong_source.level: FTA truck over a bump, 15 m

params.snr_status: assumed: sigma0 about 0 dB over ICEYE Dwell best NESZ -26.7 dB; the acquisition's calibration and noise records are not in this repository

frequency_rule: the presence (room) pair's oracle on the measured 70 m disc, largest over the FTA band
finding: One auditable comparison (BENCHMARK.md): four worlds identical but for the cavity (none; a room 6 m on a side, roof 5 m down; an L-shaped tunnel at the same depth; the room 6 m east), the same source, scatterers and noise law in each, the whole image observed, the tail beyond the measured 70 m an assumed envelope. Quiet ground (Giza's regional microseisms, expected over the field): every pair near chance on every layer, any single-image reader at most 2.5e-07 above its false-alarm rate, the oracle told every scatterer's reflectivity at most 3.8e-06 at 30 dB (assumed); the differential motion would have to grow 3.1e+06 times (single image) and 3.5e+05 times (oracle) to reach 95% found at 5%. Favourable strong shaking (a truck over a bump 15 m away, its FTA level held at 69 Hz for the whole pass, the scattered wave carried unattenuated to the image's edge, 98% of it beyond the measured disc): for any method reading the one image, told the excitation and both worlds' motion but not the speckle, the per-line certificate, each line's reference holding the lorry's wave, gives presence (room) 0.033 (near chance); presence (L tunnel) 0.062 (95% at 5% excluded); location (6 m) 0.044 (near chance); shape (room or L tunnel) 0.056 (95% at 5% excluded); the worst over the band presence (room) 0.041; presence (L tunnel) 0.072; location (6 m) 0.045; shape (room or L tunnel) 0.062; under the tabulated allowances at most 0.138; the motion would have to grow 14.5 times. The oracle told every reflectivity, a privileged detector (a perfect reference image), gives at 30 dB presence (room) 0.466 (95% at 5% excluded); presence (L tunnel) 0.750 (95% at 5% excluded); location (6 m) 0.590 (95% at 5% excluded); shape (room or L tunnel) 0.702 (95% at 5% excluded) (worst over the band presence (room) 0.553; presence (L tunnel) 0.820; location (6 m) 0.598; shape (room or L tunnel) 0.751) and reaches 0.9 at presence (room) 38 dB; presence (L tunnel) 33 dB; location (6 m) 36 dB; shape (room or L tunnel) 34 dB. Pulse by pulse on fixed scenes the coherent echo difference is 0.994 +- 0.006 of the ensemble formula (0.994 +- 0.006 with the lorry's wave ten times larger); on one line of the model the exact KL is 0.157 of the certificate. The score test told the pattern (achieved, within 70 m) reaches presence (room) 0.002; presence (L tunnel) 0.004; location (6 m) 0.003; shape (room or L tunnel) 0.004; implemented on synthesised images it reaches the predicted deflection (mean shift 2.40 spreads against 2.08 predicted, with the difference amplified 800 times; AUC 0.52 at the real level). So in this benchmark one image under fully developed speckle does not reach 95% at 5% for presence, a 6 m location or shape, quiet or favourable, whatever reads it; only a detector told the reflectivity could, and only at an SNR above the assumed one. It rests on the elastic model without attenuation, the tail envelope, the speckle model (bright points are covered by the oracle only) and the assumed SNR.
